essence: Mis-knowing described as freedom; bondage dreadful-to-fools, nothing second.

sections.SUMMARY: Then its cause is named: missing this freedom is itself freedom under description — and that mis-knowing is bondage, dreadful to the deluded.

rasa.sthayibhava: bhayānaka tempered: dread for fools, freedom beneath
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is tempered dread: terror named, freedom underneath. Naming relished.
